author: Viktor

extraction.selected_components: Column, cast mounting collar, flange plate and associated mounting fasteners.
extraction.origin: X/Z centre of the column seeded 4270; Y is the lower mounting-plate plane from component 2601.
extraction.attributes: Source shape, UV records and triangle order retained; normals normalized. Discovery welding does not merge delivered vertices. Godot performs its normal glTF conversion and tangent generation.

cast_albedo.jpg.role: Original provider sRGB JPEG; no resize or re-encoding.

cast_normal.webp.role: Linear OpenGL tangent normal; resized in float precision and renormalized before nearest RGB8 encoding.

cast_arm.webp.role: Linear red occlusion, green roughness and blue metallic; float Lanczos resize and nearest RGB8 encoding.

preparation.data_delivery: Lossless WebP decodes to the exact prepared pixels. No channel reorder, normal-axis flip or color-space conversion.
preparation.source_material: Original double-sided shading with default unit color, metallic and roughness factors; selected packed maps retain their channel meanings.

assembly.choice: Reuse one complete support twice. Keep the current plinth and work interfaces; source mounting hardware replaces the old rectangular upright covers.

limits: Presentation only. No source scene, collider, controller, drive relationship, quantity or state authority is instantiated. Raw captured assets are supported; packaged exports, native positive contact, rendered quality, GPU cost and human acceptance are unverified.
